title: Audio-magnetotelluric station location map and data log for Charleston, South Carolina
citation: Senterfit, R.M., and Huff, W., 1977, Audio-magnetotelluric station location map and data log for Charleston, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Open-File Report OF-77-342, map scale 1:250,000.
notes:
Audio-magnetotelluric (AMT) station location map (plate, p. 1, OCR) and data log (pp. 3-10). The data log tabulates observed apparent resistivity (ohm-metres), number of observations and standard error at frequencies from 7.5 Hz to 18.6 kHz for each station, but the tables are handwritten and the text layer is garbled: station numbers and values cannot be read reliably, so none were recorded. The schema has no fields for geophysical soundings in any case. The plate shows only place names (Lake Marion, Lake Moultrie, Santee National Wildlife Refuge) and no legible station numbers. The report says it is preliminary and not reviewed for USGS standards (p. 2). No geologic units, borings, structures or references.
SUBSURFACE: AMT apparent-resistivity soundings by station (pp. 3-10) could constrain depth to resistive basement or saline water but are illegible in the text layer; a reading from the original images would be needed. No elevations, datum, cross sections or contour maps.
